description: This file defines the 'OpenIdProvider' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_openid_provider' database table. It includes properties for provider ID, name, URL, and status, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OpenIdProvider
classes.description: Entity class representing an OpenID provider, including its ID, name, URL, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setProviderName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getProviderUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setProviderUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status (active/inactive) of the provider.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status (active/inactive) of the provider.
